description: Typography component — enforces the DS type ramp via CSS classes. Replaces @ui/typography. Use instead of bare HTML tags with inline font-size/weight.

ds-text-title.usage: Full-page error states ONLY — never in sub-header or body content

ds-text-heading.usage: Section headings, modal titles, card headers

ds-text-body.usage: Default body text, table cells, form labels, descriptions

ds-text-caption.usage: Breadcrumbs, meta info, secondary labels, table header text

ds-text-mono.usage: Code values, IDs, CVE numbers, hash strings

css: .ds-text-title     { font-size:18px; font-weight:700; line-height:1.2; color:var(--shell-text); font-family:inherit; } .ds-text-heading   { font-size:14px; font-weight:600; line-height:1.3; color:var(--shell-text); font-family:inherit; } .ds-text-subheader { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; line-height:1.4; color:var(--shell-text); font-family:inherit; } .ds-text-body      { font-size:12px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.5; color:var(--shell-text-2); font-family:inherit; } .ds-text-caption   { font-size:11px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.5; color:var(--shell-text-muted); font-family:inherit; } .ds-text-mono      { font-size:12px; font-weight:400; line-height:1.5; color:var(--shell-text-2); font-family:'SF Mono','Fira Code',monospace; }

truncation.single_line: Add class ds-text--truncate: overflow:hidden; white-space:nowrap; text-overflow:ellipsis; max-width:100%;

element_mapping.ds-text-title: Use on <h1> — only in full-page error states
element_mapping.ds-text-heading: Use on <h2>, <h3>, or <div> — never skip heading levels

example_html.heading: Section Title
example_html.caption: Last updated 2h ago
example_html.truncate: Long text that gets truncated

react.example:
<Typography variant="heading">Section Title</Typography>
<Typography variant="body" color="muted">Secondary text</Typography>
<Typography variant="mono">CVE-2024-1234</Typography>
<Typography variant="caption" truncate>Long label</Typography>

do: Always use ds-text-* classes instead of inline font-size/font-weight.
Use ds-text-heading for section titles and modal titles.
Use ds-text-caption for table header labels (pair with text-transform:uppercase).
Use ds-text-mono for IDs, CVEs, hashes, and code values.
Apply color modifiers (ds-text--muted, ds-text--accent) instead of hardcoding hex.
dont: Never use inline style="font-size:14px" — use ds-text-heading instead.
Never use ds-text-title outside a full-page error state.
Never use <h1> in body content — sub-header title uses ds-text-subheader on a <div>.
Never mix raw <b>/<strong> tags — use font-weight via the class instead.
Never skip heading levels (e.g. heading immediately followed by caption with no body).
